h: Seven Circuits with the Sefer Torah: Turn from Evil and Do Good

p: בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג פִּינְחָס רנו, ב):
In the Ra'aya Mehemna (Zohar III, Pinchas 256b):
and it is called Simchas Torah,
and they adorn the Sefer Torah
And so it is in the Tikkunim
there are the sukkah and the four species,
which is not the case on Atzeres,
when there is no action or mitzvah,
and the rejoicing is only with the Torah;
it is on the second day of Yom Tov.
that on all the days of the festival
one circles with the lulav and the species,
for it is found in the Gemara (Sukkah 37b):
in order to hold back harmful winds" —
that is, the desires in the heart,
"whatever is in his spirit to do,"
in order to hold back harmful dews" —
that is, external wisdoms and opinions
For just as the Torah she'b'al peh
"My word shall drip like the dew" —
meaning that a person does not sense
how it comes to him from Hashem, may He be blessed,
and thinks that he innovates it from his own mind —
and they are called harmful dews.
And for this reason one circles
with the four species for the seven days,
so that the holiness of the seven shepherds,
who are a chariot for the seven attributes,
may help to remove the evil.
And afterward, on the eighth day,
so that the holiness of the seven shepherds may help
to bring the words of Torah into the heart.
For although from the side of Hashem, may He be blessed,
first the words of Torah were fixed in the heart
and afterward the evil was uprooted,
(שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה א, ב, ד, עַל הַפָּסוּק יִשָּׁקֵנִי):
(Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:4, on the verse "Let him kiss me"):
the learning of Torah was implanted in their hearts," etc.;
the evil inclination was uprooted from their hearts" —
but from the side of man it is the reverse:
סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב (תְּהִלִּים לד, טו),
for it is impossible for him to merit
bringing words of Torah into the heart
until he removes the evil from the heart.
to hold back harmful winds and harmful dews;
and afterward one circles with the Sefer Torah
to bring the words of Torah into the heart,
so that the holiness of the seven shepherds may help,
for all of them brought down words of Torah.
with him began the two thousand years of Torah.
"the Torah issued from the side of Gevurah,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קְדוֹשִׁים פ, ב).
כְּתִיב (מִיכָה ז, כ) תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב,
it is written (Michah 7:20), "Grant truth to Yaakov,"
and "truth" means nothing other than Torah,
and so it is in the Gemara (Berachos 5b):
brought down the Torah from Heaven.
And Aharon draws them close to Torah.
Yosef is the "son of old age,"
from Shem and Ever he transmitted to him.
And Yosef is also the channel
And David is a chariot for the attribute of Malchus;
we call it the Torah she'b'al peh"
all the Ushpizin come of their own accord,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק ג אֱמוֹר קד, ב):
as is written (in the holy Zohar III, Emor 104b):
so that the holiness of the seven shepherds may help
to bring the words of Torah into the heart.
for every year on Rosh Hashanah
there is a renewal in words of Torah,
that this is why it is called Rosh Hashanah
and not "the beginning of the year":
only that it is a head and a renewal
corresponding to the years of his reign,"
for according to his mistaken view
that it was for Hashem, may He be blessed.
when all past deeds have been rectified,
the overall theme of the Festival of Ingathering,
all the doing of mitzvos from the whole year
and therefore on the festival there come
the sukkah and the four species.
then, since the deeds have been rectified,
automatically there are many words of Torah
and one circles with the Sefer Torah
to bring the words of Torah into the heart.
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה א, א, א):
as they said in the Midrash (Koheles Rabbah 1:1:1):
"From here we learn that one makes a meal
at the completion of the Torah."
in that he acquired all wisdom,
what he had not known before;
whereas we begin to study again the Torah
that was read in the past year.
there is a renewal from Rosh Hashanah
in words of Torah, as stated,
when the deeds of the past have been rectified,
then one begins the Torah anew,
and one senses a renewed taste
and makes a meal at the completion of the Torah,
and circles with the Sefer Torah
so that the words of Torah enter the heart;
who are a chariot for the seven attributes,
so that their holiness may help
to bring the words of Torah into the heart.

Seven circuits with the Sefer Torah
From Hashem's side and from man's
The Torah in each of the seven shepherds
A meal at the completion of the Torah

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 256b (Ra'aya Meheimna, Pinchas) — "'On the eighth day an assembly… one bull, one ram' (Bamidbar 29:35–36) — the masters of the Mishnah explained it as a king who invited guests; after he sent them off, he said to the members of his household: You and I will make a small meal… And Israel are accustomed to make rejoicing with her, and it is called Simchas Torah, and they adorn the Sefer Torah with its crown."

paragraphs.text: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 21, 56a — "At that time of Simchas Torah… a crown rests on the head of every tzaddik above, 'with the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding and on the day of the joy of his heart' (Shir HaShirim 3:11): 'on the day of his wedding' — this is the lower Shechinah; 'and on the day of the joy of his heart' — this is the upper Shechinah."

paragraphs.text: Sukkah 37b — "In the West they taught thus: Rabbi Chama bar Ukva said in the name of Rabbi Yosi son of Rabbi Chanina: One moves them forth and back in order to hold back harmful winds, up and down in order to hold back harmful dews."

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 80b–81a (Kedoshim) — "He said to him: 'The fear of Hashem' is written, not Torah! He answered: So it is indeed, for the Torah comes from the side of Gevurah… as it is written, 'The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem' (Tehillim 111:10)." Yitzchak, the "Fear of Yitzchak," is the chariot of Gevurah.

paragraphs.text: Berachos 5b — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

paragraphs.text: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a — “You brought forth ten arrangements, and we call them ten sefirot, through which to direct concealed worlds that are not revealed and worlds that are revealed. ... Malkhut is the mouth: we call it Oral Torah.” The specific formula “Malkhut is the mouth, Oral Torah” is found in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar, in Patach Eliyahu. It complements the preceding Zohar passage about the seventh day.

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 104b (Emor) — "And this day, Yaakov is at the head of the rejoicing, and all those guests rejoice with him; therefore it is written, 'Fortunate are you, Israel; who is like you' (Devarim 33:29), and it is written, 'And He said to me: You are My servant, Israel, in whom I glory' (Yeshayahu 49:3)."

paragraphs.text: Sanhedrin 103b — "Our Rabbis taught: Menasheh would study fifty-five facets in Toras Kohanim, corresponding to the years of his reign; Achav, eighty-five; Yeravam, one hundred and three." Rashi: every year he would innovate in the book of Vayikra and expound it with his dialectic.
